info.title: StrideHub Training API
info.description: Single-athlete, self-hosted training API. PUT merges supplied fields. Existing record mutations require expected version. Dates in queries use runner profile timezone. Never retry a 409 by blindly replacing the version.

get.description: Defaults to today and previous seven local days. Includes ended planned/completed non-rest sessions with absent, missing or overlapping links. Candidates match the local calendar day or adjacent six-hour window; other sessions' linked activities are excluded. Individual comparison is available for future or already linked sessions.

get.summary: Read paged unresolved training work, including older-history navigation
get.description: Defaults to the latest 30 profile-local calendar dates. Inclusive date range is limited to 366 dates; pageSize is 1–50. Sessions are sorted by start time ascending. Page numbers beyond the last page are clamped; an empty result has page=1 and totalPages=1. olderPendingCount and earliestPendingDate describe unresolved sessions before from, independently of the current page. Candidate searches are deferred to individual comparison. No completion or other state is changed.

Activity.description: 统一跑步记录，包含文件导入和 Zepp 云端跑步；已确认的来源别名折叠到同一 ID。缺失测量保持 null。

conditionsTraining.description: Original weather/check-in advice retained when the overall advice requires constraint review.

HabitualSession.description: Unsaved suggestion inferred from explicit running habits; has no persisted id/version. Explicit sessions on that day suppress the habit.

FeedbackFuel.description: Session-level actual fueling summary, separate from timed fuel logs. Unknown quantities are null, never zero by default.

pain.description: null means not reported; false means explicitly no pain.

activityIds.description: Full replacement of linked activity IDs. Each activity can belong to only one session. Empty array unlinks without changing status.

ActualWorkout.description: Sum of canonical linked workouts, not the time gap between files. Missing measurements remain null. Missing or overlapping linked records invalidate delta; interval compliance is not inferred.

ApplicableHealth.description: Declared active constraints applicable on the session/profile-local date. Null validFrom has no specified start; reviewOn never expires a constraint.

Today.description: Read-only runner-local today. No synthetic rest day or next-day workout; feedback queue covers today and previous six days. Fetch a chosen session briefing separately so weather failure does not block daily operations. followUps provides the first page of the latest 30 days plus pointers to older unresolved work; legacy pendingFeedback and reconciliation remain available.

HealthObservations.description: Read-only observations for the requested day. Blood pressure uses profile timezone; Zepp sleep matches actual wake time in profile timezone. Future or uncertain wake times are excluded. Manual check-ins remain separate. No automatic plan changes.

measuredAt.description: 实际测量时间，必须有秒和时区偏移，禁止小数秒。响应规范化为带数字偏移的 ISO 8601（Z 变为 +00:00）。

systolic.description: 收缩压，mmHg；必须大于 diastolic。边界仅用于数据校验，不表示正常范围。

id.description: 稳定来源 ID，由单向账号标识与 Zepp sourceDate 生成；调用方原样使用，不解析账号。

sourceDate.description: Zepp 原始日记录日期；稳定 ID 的日期部分。

date.description: 用于筛选和今日展示的归属日期：来源时区和结束时间均已知时取该时区的醒来日期，否则保留 sourceDate。

timeZone.description: 上游提供的固定 UTC 偏移；未提供时为 null，不从服务器所在地猜测。

startedAt.description: Zepp 开始时间；未知来源时区时已知 Unix 时间戳仍可表示为 UTC。

endedAt.description: Zepp 结束时间；未知来源时区时已知 Unix 时间戳仍可表示为 UTC。

totalMinutes.description: 由完整可用分期求和：deep+light+REM；上游明确不支持 REM 时为 deep+light。其余缺失情况为 null，不用睡眠区间长度代替实际睡眠。

remMinutes.description: 不支持 REM 或未返回时为 null，不能视为测得 0。

score.description: 设备评分，非后端临床评估。

restingHeartRate.description: Zepp 睡眠摘要中的静息心率，bpm；缺失保持 null。

lastSyncedAt.description: 该记录内容最近一次导入或更新的时间；云端返回相同内容时此值和 version 不变。每次成功云端读取时间看同步状态 lastSuccessAt。

HealthSleepRecord.description: Zepp 设备观察，所有未知指标为 null。独立于人工 check-in，不表示临床睡眠诊断。当前每个来源日期保留一条摘要，多设备重复日记录择较完整/较长记录；不是所有午睡片段明细。

configured.description: 服务端凭据文件存在；不保证其可读、格式正确或 Zepp 授权仍有效。

lastSuccessAt.description: 最近成功读取 Zepp 的时间，包括成功读取但没有有效睡眠的 no_data；失败不会清空历史成功时间。

lastError.description: 安全的同步错误摘要，不包含上游原始响应或凭据。

nextAction.description: 可执行的配置、重新授权或重试提示。

recordCount.description: 已保存睡眠记录总数，不等于本次导入数。

HealthSleepSyncStatus.description: GET status 和 POST sync 使用相同顶层结构；四项计数属于最近一次同步尝试。失败和空数据不删除已有睡眠，进行中超过五分钟会显示可重试的中断错误。

earliestPendingDate.description: Earliest unresolved session date before from, or null when there is none.

FollowUps.description: One item per non-rest, non-skipped/cancelled session, potentially with multiple reasons. unrecorded: planned end has passed and no activity is linked; this does not mean a missed workout. unlinked: explicitly completed without an activity. needs_review: a linked record is missing/deleted/not a run, or linked recording intervals overlap. feedback: completed with no meaningful feedback. Empty objects, nulls, blank text and unknown fuel comfort do not close feedback; explicit false pain or zero fuel quantities do. Future sessions and planned sessions still in progress are excluded. Sessions older than the displayed window remain counted until resolved.
